title: Choose the posting flow
question: Which structure should the design develop? These are layout schematics, not an app prototype. Both retain an explicit review step and honest Instagram status.

options.label: Choose, write, review
options.thesis: Choose destinations first, then write with their requirements already visible.
options.viewport: Android top bar and three labeled stages; destination rows lead, with Continue anchored below.
options.risk: Clear for first use, but adds a step to every routine post.

raised.raise: Every status has explicit text and a stable reading order.
Platform length limits appear beside the version they constrain.
The same destination status row carries through setup, review, and results.
A disciplined spacing grid aligns labels and actions.
Media order remains legible at thumbnail size.
The one next action has stronger visual emphasis than supporting detail.

options.label: Write, tailor, review
options.lineage: Personal field notes: one working draft with clear annotations
options.thesis: Start with a shared post; tailor only the destinations that need it.
options.viewport: Android top bar, destination chips, a generous shared editor, ordered media, and a Review post action.
options.risk: A familiar composer; platform differences must remain visible as concise status rows.

canonCard.label: A separate editor for each platform
canonCard.thesis: Start from shared content, then work through conventional platform tabs.
canonCard.viewport: A platform tab bar above one editor, with a final review screen.
canonCard.risk: Makes platform differences obvious, but hides the shared draft and invites repeated editing.
